prompt: I'm analysing the baskets of goods and services used to measure consumer price inflation by the Office of National Statistics. On the ONS website, in the tables showing the allocation of items to 'Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs' (CPIH) divisions for 2020-2024 (inclusive), which categories, if any, experienced fluctuations in figures of representative items (per cent of total) over the course of this period? List the categories in alphabetical order, separated by a comma and a space.
instruction: I'm analysing the baskets of goods and services used to measure consumer price inflation by the Office of National Statistics. On the ONS website, in the tables showing the allocation of items to 'Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs' (CPIH) divisions for 2020-2024 (inclusive), which categories, if any, experienced fluctuations in figures of representative items (per cent of total) over the course of this period? List the categories in alphabetical order, separated by a comma and a space.
answer:
Based on the ONS "Consumer price inflation basket of goods and services" articles for 2020–2024, Table 1 in each article shows the "Representative items (per cent of total)" for the 12 CPIH divisions. Comparing the values across the five years:

**Categories with fluctuations (at least one year differs):**
- **Clothing & footwear**: 11 (2020) → 12 (2021–2024)
- **Food & non-alcoholic beverages**: 24 (2020–2023) → 25 (2024)
- **Housing & household services**: 5 (2020–2022) → 4 (2023–2024)
- **Miscellaneous goods & services**: 11 (2020) → 10 (2021) → 11 (2022) → 10 (2023–2024)
- **Restaurants & hotels**: 7 (2020–2022) → 6 (2023–2024)
- **Transport**: 6 (2020–2022) → 7 (2023–2024)

**Categories with no change across 2020–2024:**
Alcohol & tobacco (4), Communication (2), Education (1), Furniture & household goods (10), Health (3), Recreation & culture (17)

Clothing & footwear, Food & non-alcoholic beverages, Housing & household services, Miscellaneous goods & services, Restaurants & hotels, Transport
expected_answer: Clothing & footwear, Food & non-alcoholic beverages, Housing & household services, Miscellaneous goods and services, Restaurants & hotels, Transport
